text:
Maura: FYI - multiple EU customers opened tickets saying requests are very slow and some 401s. Traces show traffic getting routed to us-west. Any idea?
Jon: seeing the same in monitoring. huge latency spike ~03:14 UTC and a bunch of 401s from auth. Not all EU requests, but a clear subset.
Alex: i'm pulling envoy logs now. there was a route table reload tied to a config push at 03:13:58 UTC. early signs of header rewrite on the retry/fallback path.
Priya: can you paste a sample request/customer repro? need to attach to the incident.
Maura: customer sent this minimal repro:
```
curl -v -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token-from-eu-issuer>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate
```
Response chain: 200 from eu-origin for some, but for others we see 302 -> backend us-west with header X-Routed-Region: us-west-1 and then 401 from auth service.
Alex: log snippet from envoy: `03:14:22 route_selection.cpp: header 'x-region' missing on retry, falling back to default cluster 'us-west-1-prod'`
Alex: also saw: `L7Filter::rewrite_headers: preserved x-region=false on 5xx-fallback`
Jon: that matches — when routed to wrong region, tokens are considered invalid (issuer claim region mismatch) which triggers billing/duplicate auth attempts and some customers are charged for retries.
Maura: billing reported a small spike - BillingBot says ~12 customers reported extra token exchange calls.
BillingBot: billing-alert: spike in auth-exchange calls from gateway: +1400 calls between 03:14-03:20 UTC. Investigating charge variance.
Priya: immediate mitigation: can we set the gateway to preserve external region hints on fallback so X-Region isn't lost? if not, force-route eu-origin via a temporary routing rule for eu accounts.
Alex: quick config test: change L7 fallback filter `preserve_external_headers: true` and limit to `x-region,x-client-id` - should be a safe toggle. I'll run a canary in eu staging first.
Jon: can we also add a temporary rule to prefer eu clusters for requests with X-Region: eu-* while we validate?
Priya: i'll open an incident ticket and set severity. INC-12345 created, tagging eng-runtime and oncall.
Maura: customer comms: telling impacted customers we're investigating routing fallback causing auth retries and increased latency, recommending replays disabled until fixed.
Alex: rolling canary change to eu-staging now. logs show preserved header on fallback and no 401s for the sample repro. pushing to prod canary at 03:46 UTC.
DeployBot: deploy: rolling-update gateway-fallback-preserve-headers -> canary on eu-prod cluster started by Alex at 03:46:12 UTC.
Jon: monitoring looks good in canary, latency down ~60% for those sessions, auth 401s dropped to baseline.
Maura: after 20m of canary success, Priya and Alex proceed with gradual rollout. Priya to monitor for billing anomalies.
Priya: follow-up actions: 1) patch L7 filter default to preserve external region headers; 2) add unit test to ensure 'x-region' persists across retries; 3) postmortem + customer billing reconciliation with finance.
Maura: assigning postmortem to Jon + Alex + Priya. I'll draft initial customer update.
Jon: also adding a runtime alert: if routed_region != x-region for >0.1% of requests in a minute, fire alert.
Maura: thanks. closing slack thread for now, moving incident updates to INC-12345.
